LOOK_AT.say: This week's Clarion, smelling of ink, with my story on page one and my name spelled a new way.
repeat: Page one. Mr. Frame says nobody ever buys the issue they're in. I can see why.
Under my story, a notice for a lost dog. I'm in very good company.
A crackle, where the ink's still drying in the folds.
Quiet. It's said all it's going to say about me, in print.
